test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, "Can I ask a question?"

options.text: she asked whether she could ask a question.
She asked whether she might ask a question.
She said whether she could ask a question.
She asked whether she can ask a question.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She asked whether she could ask a question.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Can I ask a question?" becomes "she asked whether she could ask a question."**
